references.text: Detailed instructions about the thank offering (זֶבַח־תּוֹדָה), including what should be sacrificed with it and when it must be eaten.
Further regulations concerning the thank offering and how it is to be presented before the Lord.
Rules regarding peace offerings that must be offered correctly to be accepted (לִרְצֹנְכֶם) - the same expression is used.
The context of this verse - the requirement for unblemished sacrifices so that they may be accepted (לְרָצוֹן).
An encouragement to offer thank offerings to God and fulfill vows made to the Most High.
A call to offer thank offerings and proclaim the Lord's deeds with joy.
The psalmist's promise to bring a thank offering to the Lord.
Prophetic irony concerning Israel's thank offerings - showing that the thank offering was an established practice.
The spiritual thank offering in the new covenant - the sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess God's name.
